cause: a bundled pack is imported once into Documents/Libretro/Skins/<first 16 hex of its SHA-256>; an app update never refreshed that copy, the catalog did not show that a newer archive shipped, and reinstalling needed a replace confirmation. IPA 650 ships ec382133 (PR157) while a GameCube Original installed under 643 keeps f61e10dd. The native drawn-shape hit test of 650 falls back to rectangles on those opaque sprites.
notEstablished: which IPA was installed at 18:03 UTC is not visible in the recording; under 643 the same frames are expected, under 650 only the stale installed copy explains them. Either way the device needs the refresh below plus a build that ships it.
fix: LibretroSkinCatalogs.refreshInstalledBundledSkins (app start on iOS and the skin page): an installed skin with a bundled org.rewindbox.* identifier whose SHA-256 is not the shipped one is replaced through LibretroSkinService.replace (new copy first, selections moved, old copy deleted; rollback on failure); nothing else installed or touched.
